report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Suresh Kumar | Age: 34
Body Temperature at Scene: 19.9°C | Ambient Temperature: 31.6°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 6.1 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]
  2. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]
  3. Facial: Periorbital ecchymosis bilateral [MODERATE]
  4. Thoracic: Multiple rib fractures with internal hemorrhage [SEVERE]
  5. Dorsal: Pattern bruising consistent with impact [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Carbon Monoxide, Chloroform, GHB

RIGOR MORTIS: Partial rigor — early stage.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed pattern suggesting body repositioned post-mortem.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
